title: Bringing Lester back at the Lincoln Hotel
summary: Basie sends Jones to find Lester on 52nd Street; Lester returns to the band without a word, and Jones notes he did not drink then.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: After December of '41 the war come along but Don Byas was there with the band. When we went to the Lincoln Hotel something happened with Don Byas and Basie told me to go find Lester. Lester by that time had left the USO Show and he was playing on 52nd Street. I went round to the White Rose and got Lester and Lester didn't know what I was doing. I bought him a glass of beer. Lester didn't know how to drink no anything about beer; Lester didn't drink at that time.

No. He might drink a little wine; he didn't know nothing about drinking, you know what I mean. He didn't know about drinking no gin or nothing. See, Lester didn't start drinking till later on. Lester was good in his past highest 30's, almost 40 years old before he learned about drinking. He didn't care nothing about drinking. All he knew was playing, you see. I went down on the Street and told him, "You're due at work tomorrow night at 7 o'clock. You come to the Lincoln Hotel, etcetera." And there he was! Nobody said nothing; he just sat down and just started to playing, and nobody thought about nothing. They didn't say, "Hello, Lester, where have you been?" or nothing. He came back in the band just like he'd just left 15 minutes ago.
Beautiful. So it was all straight then, huh?
Of course it was. There was no problem.
